description_en: Obtains the analysis results of a Hive database
description_zh: 获取 Hive 库维度分析结果
kebab_example: aliyun emr get-doctor-hive-database --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --date-time 2023-01-01 --database-name db1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDoctorHiveDatabase

Data.description_en: The analysis results of the Hive database

HiveDistributionScore.description_en: The score for the file sizes of the Hive database

HiveFrequencyScore.description_en: The score for the access frequency of the Hive database

HiveScore.description_en: The overall score of the Hive database

ColdDataDayGrowthSize.description_en: The daily increment of the amount of cold data. Cold data refers to data that is not accessed for more than 30 days but is accessed in previous 90 days
